problem: writeExportFile catches every mkdir/writeFile failure and only prints it when KERYX_VERBOSE is set; it never rethrows or sets an exit code.
impact: When the export path is unwritable (read-only dir, permission denied, a parent that is a file), runHistoryExport still prints 'exported N run(s) to <file>' and exits 0, so the user or a script believes the file exists when nothing was written.

problem: The exported collectRunRows catches the listWikiRuns failure and rethrows a new Error without { cause: error }, discarding the original error (errno/parse detail and stack).
impact: Anyone diagnosing a failed export sees only a generic message; the underlying cause is lost at the module boundary.
quote: throw new Error("wiki history: could not read the runs log");

problem: runHistoryExport is ~58 lines and mixes CLI orchestration (usage, exit codes, collecting, writing, printing) with low-level parsing and string work (format inference from the file extension, --since date normalisation regex, timestamp trimming, display-path resolution).
impact: One concern (e.g. --since parsing or format inference) cannot be tested or changed without reading the whole command flow; the parsing logic is not reusable.
quote: export async function runHistoryExport(args: string[], cwd: string = process.cwd()): Promise<void> {

problem: renderRunLine takes four positional parameters (run, at, pages, markdown) and the boolean flag switches it between two different output formats; at/pages also duplicate fields already on run.
impact: Call sites read as renderRunLine(run, at, run.pages, format === "md") with no name on the boolean; the function does two jobs and should be two renderers or take the format enum.
quote: export function renderRunLine(run: WikiRunSummary, at: string, pages: number, markdown: boolean): string {

problem: The same 5-line command-label sanitising block (strip newlines, collapse whitespace, trim, slice to MAX_COMMAND_WIDTH) is copy-pasted in three places: src/commands/wiki-history-export.ts:49 (markdown branch), src/commands/wiki-history-export.ts:56 (CSV branch), and src/commands/wiki-history.ts:47 (text --runs listing).
impact: Any change to how labels are cleaned or clipped has to be made three times and the copies will drift; it should be one helper.

problem: The doc comment on collectRunRows says it returns the runs oldest first, but the function only filters listWikiRuns output, which is sorted newest first; nothing re-sorts.
impact: Readers and callers relying on the comment expect chronological order; the exported file is actually newest first, contradicting the documented contract.
quote: oldest first, so the exported file reads in the order the writes happened.
